scenario: When a candidate's status changes to 'Offer Accepted' in the ATS, read the offer details (start date, department, manager, location) and create the employee record in the HRIS, add a row to the onboarding tracker sheet, and post a welcome heads-up to the hiring manager's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: start-date lead times, location-specific onboarding checklist

scenario: When a DocuSign envelope for an offer letter is completed, download the signed PDF to the candidate's Google Drive folder, update the ATS stage to 'Hired', and email the recruiter and payroll with the agreed salary and start date.
rule_hooks: envelope template type mapping to ATS stages

scenario: When an employee emails HR a resignation letter, look up their record in the HRIS, compute their last working day from the notice period in their contract, open an offboarding ticket in the HR helpdesk, and notify their manager and IT in Slack.
rule_hooks: notice period by role level and country

scenario: When an involuntary termination is marked effective in the HRIS, create urgent tickets in the IT project board for same-day access removal, update the equipment-return sheet, and send the payroll contact the final-pay deadline.
rule_hooks: state final-paycheck timing laws

scenario: When a time-off request form submission arrives, read the employee's remaining PTO balance from the leave sheet, approve or flag it, add the event to the team's shared Google Calendar, and reply to the employee with the outcome.
rule_hooks: accrual balance, blackout dates, max consecutive days

scenario: When an employee logs a sick day in the absence tracker that brings their consecutive sick days to three or more, create a Zendesk HR ticket requesting a medical certificate and email the employee the upload instructions.
rule_hooks: consecutive-day threshold for medical documentation

scenario: When a parental leave request comes in through the HR helpdesk, read the employee's tenure and location from the HRIS, record the leave dates and pay type in the leave register sheet, and notify the benefits administrator and manager of the coverage period.
rule_hooks: eligibility by tenure, statutory vs. company-paid weeks by country

scenario: When a compensation change is approved in the HRIS, append the new rate and effective date to the current pay-period payroll input sheet and email the payroll provider contact, holding it to the next cycle if after cutoff.
rule_hooks: payroll cutoff calendar, effective-date proration

scenario: When an employee submits a direct-deposit change form, create a verification task in the HR helpdesk, call-back note for the HR generalist, and only after verification mark the payroll input sheet row as ready, notifying the employee by email.
rule_hooks: fraud-prevention verification policy, payroll cutoff

scenario: When a weekly timesheet is submitted in the time-tracking sheet showing more than 40 hours for a non-exempt employee, add an overtime line to the payroll input sheet and message the manager in Slack to confirm the hours were authorized.
rule_hooks: FLSA exempt status, weekly/daily overtime thresholds

scenario: When an employee reports a marriage or birth via the benefits request form, check the event date against the special-enrollment window, open a benefits change case in Freshdesk, and email the employee the enrollment link and deadline.
rule_hooks: 30/60-day qualifying life event windows

scenario: When an employee's scheduled hours are changed in the HRIS from full-time to part-time, check whether they drop below the benefits eligibility threshold, update the benefits roster sheet, and notify the benefits broker and the employee of coverage end or COBRA.
rule_hooks: hours-per-week benefits eligibility threshold

scenario: When a new hire's first day is marked in the onboarding tracker, create a calendar deadline for I-9 Section 2 completion three business days later, assign a task to the HR coordinator in Asana, and email the new hire the list of acceptable documents.
rule_hooks: I-9 three-business-day rule, holiday calendar

scenario: When the LMS export shows an employee's mandatory harassment-prevention training has passed its due date, update the compliance sheet status to 'Overdue', email the employee a reminder, and notify their manager in Slack if it is more than 14 days late.
rule_hooks: escalation tiers by days overdue, state training mandates

scenario: When a licensed employee's certification expiry date in the credentials sheet comes within 60 days, create a renewal task in the project board, email the employee, and copy their manager if the role cannot legally work without it.
rule_hooks: role-required license list, renewal lead time

scenario: When a manager submits a performance review form, record the rating in the review cycle sheet, and if the rating is 'Exceeds' or 'Below Expectations' add the employee to the calibration session agenda doc and notify the HR business partner.
rule_hooks: rating scale and calibration criteria

scenario: When an HRBP marks a performance improvement plan as approved in the employee relations tracker, create the PIP check-in meetings on the manager's and employee's calendars at 30/60/90 days and send the PIP document for signature via DocuSign.
rule_hooks: PIP duration and check-in cadence policy

scenario: When a promotion request is marked approved in the HR helpdesk, update the employee's title and job level in the HRIS, add the salary change to payroll inputs, update the org chart sheet, and draft the announcement in the department Slack channel.
rule_hooks: job level salary bands

scenario: When an interview's scheduled end time passes by 24 hours without a scorecard in the ATS, send the interviewer a Slack reminder and, at 48 hours, notify the recruiter so they can follow up before the debrief.
rule_hooks: scorecard SLA hours

scenario: When a hiring debrief decision of 'No Hire' is logged in the ATS, move the candidate to the rejected stage with the reason code, schedule the templated rejection email for the next business morning, and log the disposition in the EEO reporting sheet.
rule_hooks: rejection template by stage reached, disposition codes

scenario: When a referred candidate is marked hired in the ATS, look up the referring employee, add a pending referral bonus entry to the payroll input sheet dated after the new hire's 90-day mark, and email the referrer a thank-you note.
rule_hooks: referral bonus amounts by role level, payout waiting period

scenario: When the background check vendor emails a completed report, update the candidate's ATS record, and if the result is 'Consider' create a confidential adverse-action review ticket for HR legal rather than clearing the start date.
rule_hooks: FCRA adverse action process, clear vs. consider results

scenario: When a manager submits a contractor extension request, check the contractor's total tenure against the co-employment limit in the contractor register sheet, update the end date if allowed, and notify procurement and the staffing agency by email.
rule_hooks: max contractor tenure, PO budget remaining

scenario: When a new hire's probation end date is two weeks away according to the HRIS, create a probation review task for the manager, send them the review form link, and calendar a confirmation meeting with HR.
rule_hooks: probation length by country and role

scenario: When an employee reaches a service milestone (5, 10, 15 years) per their HRIS hire date, post a recognition message in the #kudos Slack channel, add the anniversary gift order to the rewards sheet, and email their manager.
rule_hooks: milestone years and gift tiers

scenario: When an employee's manager field changes in the HRIS, update the org chart sheet, reassign their open PTO approvals and review forms to the new manager, and send an intro email to both.
rule_hooks: approval delegation rules

scenario: When an employee submits a change-of-address form showing a move to a different state, update their work location in the HRIS, flag the state tax withholding change in the payroll input sheet, and open a ticket for HR to check registration in the new state.
rule_hooks: registered payroll states list, remote work policy

scenario: When an employee submits a tuition reimbursement request with grades attached, check the annual cap and remaining balance in the education assistance sheet, create the reimbursement bill in QuickBooks if eligible, and email the employee the decision.
rule_hooks: annual tuition cap, minimum grade, retention clause

scenario: When a message arrives in the confidential ethics inbox, create a restricted case in the HR helpdesk assigned to the employee relations lead, log it in the investigations register with a case ID, and send the reporter an acknowledgement without copying their manager.
rule_hooks: case severity categories, conflict-of-interest routing

scenario: When a workplace incident form is submitted reporting an injury, log it in the OSHA 300 log sheet, notify the workers' comp carrier contact and the site safety lead by email, and create a follow-up task for return-to-work clearance.
rule_hooks: OSHA recordability criteria, reporting deadlines

scenario: When an employee's leave end date arrives in the leave register, change their HRIS status back to active, re-add them to payroll inputs for the next cycle, and message the manager and IT to restore system access.
rule_hooks: leave type pay status, return-to-work certification requirement

scenario: When the open enrollment window reaches its final three days, read the benefits election sheet for employees with no election recorded, email each one a reminder, and post a count to the HR team channel noting they will default to prior-year coverage.
rule_hooks: default election rules, enrollment deadline

scenario: When a new hire record's start date is set or changes in the HRIS, create or update the laptop and accounts request in the IT project tracker with the role-based equipment kit, and email the new hire's personal address to confirm the shipping address.
rule_hooks: role-based equipment kits, shipping lead time

scenario: When a new hire is added to the onboarding tracker, pick an available buddy from the same department in the buddy roster sheet, record the pairing, and create an intro Zoom meeting for the new hire's first week.
rule_hooks: buddy eligibility (tenure, max concurrent buddies)

scenario: When an offboarding ticket moves to 'Notice Confirmed', schedule an exit interview Zoom with an HRBP before the last day, send the employee the exit survey link, and record the scheduled date on the ticket.
rule_hooks: HRBP assignment by department, voluntary vs. involuntary exit

scenario: When an employee's termination date is entered in the HRIS, read their unused vacation balance from the leave sheet, add a PTO payout line to the final payroll input if their state requires it, and note the amount on the offboarding ticket.
rule_hooks: state PTO payout laws, use-it-or-lose-it policy

scenario: When a job requisition is marked fully approved in the headcount plan sheet, create the job opening in the ATS with the approved salary range, assign the recruiter, and post the opening announcement in the internal #jobs Slack channel.
rule_hooks: pay transparency laws by posting location, headcount budget

scenario: When a work visa or EAD expiration date in the immigration tracker falls within 120 days, open a case with the immigration counsel via email, create a reverification task for I-9 updates, and notify the employee and their manager.
rule_hooks: visa type renewal lead times, I-9 reverification rules

scenario: When a wage garnishment order arrives by email in the payroll inbox, create a confidential payroll ticket, add the deduction amount and start date to the payroll input sheet, and send the employee the required notice letter.
rule_hooks: garnishment priority and federal/state withholding limits

scenario: When a revised employee handbook is published and DocuSign acknowledgement envelopes are sent, track completions daily, update the acknowledgement sheet when envelopes are signed, and send reminders to employees still pending after five days.
rule_hooks: acknowledgement deadline, reminder cadence

scenario: When a candidate misses a scheduled Zoom interview (no join recorded and the interviewer flags it in Slack), the ATS stage is set to 'No Show', the candidate gets one reschedule link by Gmail, and the recruiter is notified; a second no-show moves the candidate to Rejected.
rule_hooks: one-reschedule policy, no-show count per candidate

scenario: When a candidate declines an offer in the ATS, the requisition is set back to 'Open - Sourcing', the hiring manager and recruiter are told in Slack, and any runner-up finalists interviewed in the last 30 days are listed in the hiring sheet for possible outreach.
rule_hooks: runner-up recency window, req status transitions

scenario: When an employee applies to an internal posting, HR checks the HRIS for tenure and current performance status; eligible applicants advance, and their current manager is emailed only once the candidate passes the first interview, as the transfer policy requires.
rule_hooks: internal mobility eligibility (tenure, no active PIP), manager notification timing

scenario: When an employee emails a jury summons, a Jury Duty leave entry is created in the HRIS for the summons dates, the manager is notified, and payroll gets an input that says whether the days are paid, based on the employee's work state.
rule_hooks: state jury-duty pay laws, company paid-day cap

scenario: When a bereavement request comes in through the HR helpdesk, the stated relationship is looked up in the policy table to set the number of paid days, the leave is recorded in the HRIS and the team calendar, and the manager receives a short, sensitive notice.
rule_hooks: relationship-to-days entitlement table, travel extension rule

scenario: When an employee submits a name change with supporting documentation, the HRIS and payroll profiles are updated, the benefits carrier change form is sent, and IT gets a ticket for the email alias and directory display name.
rule_hooks: required documentation types, systems-of-record update list

scenario: When a covered dependent's 26th birthday is 30 days away in the benefits census sheet, the employee is emailed about the coverage end date, the carrier termination is queued, and the COBRA administrator is notified to send the dependent's election packet.
rule_hooks: dependent age limit, coverage end-of-month rule

scenario: When a termination becomes effective in the HRIS for a benefits-enrolled employee, a COBRA qualifying event is logged with the benefits administrator, the election notice deadline is tracked in the compliance sheet, and HR ops is alerted if it isn't sent within the deadline.
rule_hooks: COBRA 44-day notice deadline, enrolled-plan check

scenario: When an employee submits a 401(k) deferral change form, the new percentage is checked against the plan maximum and the IRS annual limit given year-to-date contributions, the payroll input sheet is updated for the next eligible pay period, and the employee gets a confirmation.
rule_hooks: IRS deferral limit, catch-up eligibility at 50, payroll cutoff date

scenario: When a manager approves a timesheet after the payroll cutoff, the missed hours are calculated, an off-cycle payment request is filed with the payroll provider if the shortfall is above the threshold, and otherwise it is added to the next regular run, with the employee notified either way.
rule_hooks: off-cycle dollar threshold, state final-pay timing

scenario: When a pay period closes with non-exempt employees still missing timesheets, each is sent a Slack reminder, their managers are copied after 24 hours, and the payroll tracker marks them pending so payroll doesn't run with zero hours.
rule_hooks: exempt vs non-exempt status, escalation timing

scenario: When two hourly employees request a shift swap in the scheduling tool, both are checked for role qualification and for whether the swap would push either over 40 weekly hours; valid swaps update the schedule and notify the supervisor, and others are sent back with the reason.
rule_hooks: role qualification matrix, weekly overtime threshold

scenario: When an employee requests to work remotely from a different state, the role's remote eligibility is checked, HR and finance are told whether the company is already registered as an employer in that state, and the request is routed to the manager with the tax and registration implications noted.
rule_hooks: role remote eligibility, registered-states list

scenario: When a team's monthly pulse survey results come in with an average below 3.0 or a drop of more than 0.5 points, the team's HRBP gets a Slack alert with the lowest-scoring questions and a follow-up task is created in the project tool; teams under the anonymity minimum are excluded.
rule_hooks: score threshold, minimum response count for anonymity

scenario: When an employee gets their first direct report in the HRIS, they are enrolled in the people-manager curriculum in the LMS, plus state-mandated supervisor harassment training where it applies, and receive a welcome email with the completion deadlines.
rule_hooks: role-to-curriculum matrix, state supervisor training mandates

scenario: When an employee submits a workplace accommodation request, a restricted-access case is opened in the HR helpdesk, a medical certification form is sent, the interactive-process meeting is scheduled with the accommodations specialist, and the manager is told only that a request is in progress.
rule_hooks: confidentiality access rules, response deadline

scenario: When an employee asks for leave to care for a seriously ill family member, the HRIS is checked for 12 months of service, 1,250 hours worked in the last year, and 50 employees within 75 miles; the eligibility and rights notice is sent within five business days and the leave case is logged.
rule_hooks: FMLA eligibility criteria, 5-business-day notice deadline

scenario: When a manager uploads a signed written warning, the employee's discipline history is checked to confirm the step is right under progressive discipline, the document is filed in the personnel folder, and the HRBP is alerted if steps were skipped or if a prior warning is still active.
rule_hooks: progressive discipline steps, warning active period

scenario: When a tardy or unexcused absence is logged in the timekeeping system, attendance points are added in the tracking sheet, points older than the rolling window drop off, and reaching 6 or 8 points triggers a coaching notice or final warning to the supervisor.
rule_hooks: points-per-occurrence table, rolling 12-month window

scenario: When a recruiting agency emails an invoice for a placement, the hire's start date and first-year salary are checked in the HRIS, the fee is verified against the agency's contract percentage, and the approved invoice is sent to AP in QuickBooks; if the hire left within the guarantee period, it is flagged for refund instead.
rule_hooks: agency fee %, 90-day guarantee clause

scenario: When a recruiter drafts an offer in the ATS, the base salary is compared to the job's band in the compensation sheet; offers above the midpoint need HRBP approval and offers above the maximum go to the VP and comp committee, and the offer is held until approval comes in through Slack.
rule_hooks: salary band by level and location, approval tiers

scenario: When a resignation is entered in the HRIS, the employee's offer terms are checked for a signing or relocation bonus with a repayment clause; if they leave inside the window, the prorated repayment is calculated, a payroll deduction input or repayment letter is prepared, and HR approval is requested.
rule_hooks: repayment window and proration, state deduction-from-final-pay limits

scenario: When a manager submits a full-time conversion recommendation for an intern, graduation date and final evaluation are checked, an approved new-grad requisition in that team is confirmed, and a conversion offer is drafted for the recruiter, or a waitlist entry is made if headcount isn't available.
rule_hooks: new-grad headcount availability, minimum evaluation rating

scenario: When a former employee applies through the ATS, the HRIS termination record is checked for rehire eligibility and reason code; ineligible applicants are flagged to the recruiter privately, and eligible ones who return within 12 months are tagged for seniority bridging.
rule_hooks: rehire-eligible flag, service bridging window

scenario: When a new hire's record is finalized in the HRIS, the required fields are gathered into the state new-hire report for their work state, the report is submitted or queued, and the compliance sheet tracks the filing against the state's deadline.
rule_hooks: state-specific reporting deadlines and fields

scenario: When an employee opens a helpdesk ticket saying their paycheck is short, the approved timesheet and payroll register for that period are compared; if hours or rates don't match, a correction is filed with payroll and the ticket is updated with the expected fix date, otherwise the pay breakdown is explained.
rule_hooks: pay rate and differential rules, correction timing policy

scenario: When a sales rep disputes their commission statement, the Salesforce closed-won opportunities for the period are pulled and recalculated against the rep's comp plan rates and accelerators, and the discrepancy is either sent to payroll as an adjustment or explained back to the rep, with sales ops copied.
rule_hooks: comp plan rates, accelerator tiers, crediting rules

scenario: When a manager submits a spot bonus nomination form, the department's remaining quarterly recognition budget and the employee's spot awards this year are checked; within-limit awards are added to the payroll input sheet and announced in Slack if the employee opted in, and over-limit ones go to the department head.
rule_hooks: per-employee annual cap, departmental budget

scenario: When an employee submits a wellness stipend claim with a receipt, the expense category is checked against the eligible list and the remaining annual allowance; approved amounts go into the payroll input as taxable reimbursement and the employee is told the remaining balance.
rule_hooks: eligible expense categories, annual allowance, taxable treatment

scenario: When a new hire completes their first day in the HRIS, their onboarding profile is checked for consent to share a bio, an introduction with their role, team, and manager is posted to the company's #welcome channel, and they are added to their team and location Slack channels.
rule_hooks: opt-in consent, department-to-channel mapping

scenario: When a current or former employee emails a request for a copy of their personal data, the case is logged with its statutory deadline, records are requested from HRIS, payroll, and ATS owners, and the privacy officer is notified; requests from EU or California residents follow the applicable rules.
rule_hooks: GDPR/CCPA response deadlines, identity verification

scenario: When all reference responses for a finalist are collected in the reference-check tool, they are summarized in the ATS, and any rating below 3 or a 'would not rehire' answer is flagged to the hiring manager and recruiter before the offer stage moves forward.
rule_hooks: minimum reference count, red-flag criteria

scenario: When a lender or landlord emails asking to verify an employee's employment, the HR inbox checks for a signed authorization from the employee, replies with only the fields policy allows (dates, title, and salary only if authorized), and logs the request.
rule_hooks: authorization requirement, disclosable fields policy

scenario: When a candidate is moved to the Onsite stage in the ATS, the panel defined for the requisition is checked against interviewer calendars to find a slot within five business days, Zoom links and calendar invites are created, and the candidate gets the agenda by email.
rule_hooks: req-specific panel composition, interviewer load limits

scenario: When a DocuSign offer envelope has been unsigned for three days, the candidate gets a reminder and the recruiter is pinged in Slack; at the expiry date the envelope is voided, the ATS stage is updated, and the hiring manager is notified.
rule_hooks: offer validity period, reminder cadence

scenario: When finance announces a hiring freeze for specific departments, every open requisition in those departments is set to On Hold in the ATS, job postings are unpublished, and recruiters are told which candidates are in late stages, while reqs marked as critical backfills are kept open.
rule_hooks: affected department list, critical-role exemptions

scenario: When an employee on medical leave emails to extend it, the total leave used is compared to the protected-leave maximum and updated medical certification is requested; the HRIS end date is extended, the benefits premium billing is adjusted, and the manager is told the new expected return date.
rule_hooks: protected leave maximum, certification requirements

scenario: When an offer is accepted for a candidate in a country where the company has no legal entity, the hire is routed to the employer-of-record provider with the offer details, onboarding in the regular HRIS is held, and the recruiter and finance get the EOR cost estimate.
rule_hooks: entity-by-country list, EOR provider country coverage

scenario: When a state or city minimum wage increase takes effect, hourly employees in that jurisdiction earning below the new rate are found in the HRIS, payroll rate change inputs are prepared for the effective date, and managers and affected employees are notified.
rule_hooks: jurisdiction minimum wage table, effective dates

scenario: When an employee elects supplemental life coverage above the guaranteed-issue amount, an Evidence of Insurability form is sent to them, coverage is recorded at the guaranteed-issue level until approved, and payroll deductions are set for only the approved amount.
rule_hooks: guaranteed-issue limit, carrier EOI rules
